interaction.prompt: You have the puck in the corner. One defender is crashing the wall, another is clogging the point lane. Tap the open teammate to pass to.

opts: Pass to the LW in the slot
Pass up the wall to the RW
Send it back to the LD at the point
Hold the corner and protect the puck

feedback.right: X1 loaded up on the wall, cutting off the RW but leaving the LW free in the slot. A quick pass there puts your team in a dangerous scoring position.
feedback.wrong: X1 is sitting right in the wall lane — the RW isn't open. X2 is shading the point, so the LD is covered too. The LW has stepped into the slot behind X1 with no defender in sight.

tip: When a defender cheats to the boards, they're handing you the slot. Find the teammate sneaking into the space they just gave up.
why: X1 closing hard on the wall vacates the slot entirely. At U11, the key read is noticing which zone a defender just left — not just where the puck can travel.

read.cue: X1 has stepped toward the wall lane, leaving the slot unguarded behind them
